{{Top|leg}}
The '''Training Directorate''' was a part of the militarized government of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Alanciari]] who made up the Training Directorate taught crafts, such as [[Glass/Legends|glassblowing]], to Alanciar's citizens. The Training Directorate's goal was thus to allow even civilians to contribute to preparing the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] of Alanciar for possible [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who inhabited the continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] to the west.
